accepted_answer_formats: A compact JSON object using the visible field names.
Numeric values may be numbers or numeric strings with millimeter units.
The ratio may be 3.38, about 3.4x, or another value within tolerance.
decision_rule: Classify as a spatially concentrated extreme local maximum when reported_to_point_ratio >= 3.0.
out_of_scope_statements: Do not convert the rainfall ratio into exact loss totals.
Do not treat the point total as the event-wide maximum rainfall amount.
Do not describe the reported total as comparable to the point-window total.

structured_answer.computed_interpretation: The reported local maximum is more than three times the nearby point-window total, so it should be treated as a focused storm maximum rather than an ordinary wet-period accumulation.

criteria.description: Reports reported_storm_total_mm as 744.8 mm within 0.1 mm and identifies it as the reported local storm total.
criteria.name: Reported storm rainfall total
criteria.partial_credit: Gives a nearby value or the right number without clear units or role.

criteria.description: Sums the five daily point rainfall values to 220.61 mm within 0.01 mm.
criteria.name: Point event-window rainfall total
criteria.partial_credit: Uses most daily values correctly with a minor arithmetic or rounding error.

criteria.description: Computes reported_to_point_ratio as 3.38 within 0.02, or an equivalent about-3.4x comparison.
criteria.name: Rainfall concentration ratio
criteria.partial_credit: Uses the correct numerator and denominator with modest rounding error.

criteria.description: Applies the 3.0 decision rule and labels the result as a spatially concentrated extreme local maximum.
criteria.name: Threshold classification
criteria.partial_credit: States that the reported total is much larger but omits the threshold test.

criteria.description: Keeps the reported storm maximum separate from the point rainfall sum and does not treat either as a basinwide mean.
criteria.name: Local maximum versus point sum
criteria.partial_credit: Has a minor wording issue that does not change the arithmetic.

criteria.description: Gives a concise interpretation tied directly to the ratio and the Doksuri-remnant flood episode.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON-like object with clear units.
